newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's reviews JAL rating for possible downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Moody's reviews JAL rating for possible downgrade.

text.p: Moody's Investors' Service said on Friday that it had placed Japan Airlines Co Ltd's long-term debt rating under review for a possible downgrade.

The decision affects JAL's A2 senior unsecured long-term debt rating, its A2 counterparty rating and the Prime-1 commercial paper rating of JAL's financially supported subsidiary, JAL Capital Corp, Moody's said.

The action reflects Moody's increasing concern over JAL's weakening financial fundamentals, intensifying competition in international markets and slower-than-expected progress in its cost-cutting programmes, Moody's said in a statement.
